description: Returns one compounding pharmacy from GLP Winner: licence status in a US state (licence number, expiry and the state board’s record when one is held), whether that licence covers sterile compounding, accreditations such as 503A, 503B and PCAB, FDA inspection, additives, ratings, and the providers that ship from it to that state, each with links.getStarted. The values not_checked and not_reviewed mean GLP Winner has not reviewed that item.

pharmacy.description: Pharmacy name ("Hallandale"), slug ("hallandale") or numeric GLP Winner id.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code or a full name. Licence and sterile-compounding status are for this state, and the listed providers ship from the pharmacy to this state.

name: get_glp1_pharmacy
title: Get a compounding pharmacy’s profile
